title: Free* English Classes | TAFE NSW St Leonards
meta_desc: Free* English classes for adults at TAFE NSW St Leonards. Next info day: Wednesday 09/12/2026, 10am – 4pm. Come in and have a free English test.
lang_note: Choose a language to read this page in your language.
h1_sub: for adults – from beginner to advanced
lead: Learn English to live, work and study in Australia. Come to our info day and have a free English test.
dc_where: Building P, Level 4, Room P4.02 · 213 Pacific Hwy, St Leonards
offer_sub: Flexible English classes for adults, with the support of TAFE NSW teachers, services and facilities.
o1_d: Classes at every level for adult learners.
o2_d: Choose a timetable that fits around work and family.
o3_d: Study on campus or join your class online.
o4_t: For a variety of visa holders
o4_d: Classes open to many visa types – ask us about eligibility.
o5_d: Practical English for everyday life, jobs and further study in Australia.
o6_d: Access TAFE NSW libraries, resources and student support.
steps_sub: Can't come on the info day? Just contact us or walk in.
s1_d: Come to the info day on 09/12/2026, call, email, or walk in to the campus.
s2_d: We'll check your visa / residency to confirm your eligibility, and discuss the study options available to you.
s3_d: We'll check your English level so you start in the right class.
s4_d: Choose day or evening, face-to-face or online, and start learning.
